channel.title: Lilora Houseplant Care
channel.description: Plant care guides from Lilora on watering, light, and repotting.

item.title: How to water houseplants without a rigid schedule
item.description: Check the potting mix, feel the weight of the pot, and let excess water drain. Use these cues to decide when your houseplant needs water.

item.title: Indoor plant light: a beginner’s guide to choosing a spot
item.description: Understand direct sunlight, bright indirect light and low light. Observe your window and choose a position around your plant’s needs.

item.title: Yellow houseplant leaves: what to check before you act
item.description: Check the leaf pattern, root-zone moisture, light, temperature and pests before you change the care of a houseplant with yellowing leaves.
